proj_kinase.name: Kinase Inhibitor Discovery
proj_kinase.description: Discovery program targeting EGFR and BRAF kinases for oncology indications. Focused on next-generation inhibitors with improved selectivity profiles.

proj_antiinflam.name: Anti-inflammatory Program
proj_antiinflam.description: Lead optimization of selective COX-2 inhibitors with reduced cardiovascular risk. Includes ADMET profiling and in vivo efficacy studies.

proj_cardio.name: Cardiovascular Lead Optimization
proj_cardio.description: Optimization of ACE2 modulators and angiotensin receptor antagonists for hypertension and heart failure indications.

proj_cns.name: CNS Drug Discovery
proj_cns.description: Collaborative program with NeuroTech Biopharma targeting 5-HT2A and related serotonin receptors for treatment of schizophrenia and mood disorders.
